items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: But every once in a while, I go a little higher than that squeak D.

ctx.x: So you've been able to add like -- you've been able to add more -- you've been able to get further and you've been able to go higher in the range over the years?
Well, not too much higher. But every once in a while, I go a little higher than that squeak D.
